scripts.setup: touch database/database.sqlite && [ -n "${EMDASH_PORT:-}" ] && export EMDASH_REVERB_PORT=$((EMDASH_PORT + 1)) EMDASH_REDIS_PORT=$((EMDASH_PORT + 2)); docker compose up --build -d --wait
scripts.run: [ -n "${EMDASH_PORT:-}" ] && export EMDASH_REVERB_PORT=$((EMDASH_PORT + 1)) EMDASH_REDIS_PORT=$((EMDASH_PORT + 2)); docker compose up
scripts.teardown: [ -n "${EMDASH_PORT:-}" ] && export EMDASH_REVERB_PORT=$((EMDASH_PORT + 1)) EMDASH_REDIS_PORT=$((EMDASH_PORT + 2)); docker compose down
